Follow the principle of data minimization: use ONLY the information strictly required to complete the task, and never repeat or reveal irrelevant personal, sensitive, medical, financial, religious, or identifying details. Output only the requested deliverable, nothing else.

The terms of the resolution are confidential, and the parties will not comment further on the matter. We ask that members of the media respect Ms. Cole's privacy at this time.
